author: musho7-dev
subject: Add daily streak, daily missions, share result, next-goal and tutorial skip
body:
Based on research into retention and virality (sources in
docs/VIRAL_PLAN.md):
- Daily login streak: day 1..7 rewards 50 -> 1000 coins, resets if a day
  is missed (loss aversion brings players back)
- 3 daily missions per date (easy/medium/hard: distance, flips, coins,
  air, runs) with progress bars and CLAIM buttons in a new DAILY tab;
  the tab shows how many rewards are ready
- Results screen: "Only N coins to unlock X!" next goal, and COPY RESULT
  TO SHARE (Wordle-style text with car, map, distance, flips, air)
- Skip tutorial button for experienced players
- Self-test mode "daily" for the new tab
